candidates.description: 2-4 candidate patterns of interest, each expressed as a gerund.

statement.description: Gerund candidate for the pattern of interest.

supporting_codes.description: Categories that support this candidate as the core concern.

orphan_codes.description: Categories that would be orphaned if this candidate is chosen.

rationale.description: Why this candidate emerges from the data. Cite specific hypothesis IDs.

is_latent.description: true if this is a latent concern (revealed by behavior, not stated explicitly).

rationale.description: Overall reasoning connecting the candidates to the accumulated data.

no_clear_concern.description: true if the data does not support any clear pattern of interest.
